messages:
Ivy Nakamura: hey all, day 1 here. got my MacBook but Kandji enrollment keeps failing with "network unreachable" during Setup Assistant. i'm on the office guest wifi (captive portal) because the onboarding Wi-Fi wasn't in range. any quick fixes?
Samir Desai: welcome Ivy! captive portals/powered-proxies will often block the MDM check-in. did you see any browser pop-up to accept terms on the guest wifi?
Ivy Nakamura: yes i had to authenticate on a small browser window, i thought that meant internet was fine. the Mac still shows "Waiting for MDM profile".
IT Helpdesk Bot: Auto-scan: serial C02IVY0001 shows device attempted check-in but MDM endpoint unreachable. Suggested actions: 1) connect to corp-onboard wifi or wired ethernet, 2) install proxy CA to System keychain and set to Always Trust, or 3) request IT to push profile when device has public internet. Ticket #ONB-9988 created.
Rosa Diaz: Hi Ivy, if you can tether to your phone or plug into a wired port in the office that usually fixes it. If neither is possible, we can temporarily install the corp proxy CA so the device can talk through the office proxy. Which can you do now?
Ivy Nakamura: i'm in the lobby and ethernet isn't handy. i can hotspot my phone but signal is flaky. can you outline the CA install steps? don't want to make things worse.
Samir Desai: sure — download the proxy CA from https://sso.redwood.com/proxy-ca.der, double-click to add to System keychain, authenticate with your local password, then right-click the cert -> Get Info -> Trust -> Always Trust for SSL. After that run: \n\n```\nsudo profiles renew -type enrollment\n```\n\nThat forces a check-in. If you prefer, we can push the profile remotely once you confirm the device shows online.
Ivy Nakamura: downloaded and installed the cert, ran the profiles command. Terminal returned "Enrollment profile fetched; MDM profile installed". Kandji shows device online. thank you!! :tada:
Rosa Diaz: awesome. i'll update the onboarding doc to remind new hires to avoid captive portals or to use a phone hotspot during Setup Assistant. Ivy, welcome aboard 44b and glad that worked.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #ONB-9988 resolved: proxy CA install resolved enrollment for C02IVY0001.
Ivy Nakamura: thanks everyone — adding a 1-line note to my personal onboarding checklist now.
